project.name: AIW
project.description: Vendor-neutral persistent project state and deterministic tooling for disposable coding agents.
invariants: Canonical AIW state is vendor-neutral; generated adapters never outrank it.
No model calls, services or database are required for core operations.
Completion requires fresh declared verification; logs stay outside default context.
Recovery output is bounded and source changes invalidate old evidence.

v01.title: AIW v0.1
v01.objective: Prove durable vendor-neutral recovery with verified deterministic tooling

v02.title: AIW v0.2 agent integration
v02.objective: Make AIW automatically discoverable and enforce its durable lifecycle in Codex and Claude while keeping the CLI canonical

v1.title: AIW v1 stable release
v1.objective: Ship a documented, locally deterministic, interoperable and supportable AIW release with evidence from real recovery use

agent-integration.title: Ship skills, lifecycle hooks, and user installation
acceptance: Codex and Claude discover the portable aiw-workspace skill at project and user scope
Session and subagent startup inject a bounded AIW recovery packet
Opt-in strict stop enforcement continues unfinished work once and allows blocked or terminal work
Integration preserves unrelated settings and remains idempotent
A documented user installer keeps aiw on PATH and copies both personal skills
A fresh Claude process completes hook injection, skill discovery, AIW load, and task claim without conversation history
constraints: Strict enforcement must have an explicit loop guard and cannot manufacture completion evidence

checkpoint-freshness.title: Report source changes since an active-task checkpoint
acceptance: A checkpoint records a deterministic source fingerprint for its selected task without changing verification evidence semantics
Load and status report when the active task has scoped source changes after its latest checkpoint
Strict-stop output directs an agent to persist a checkpoint when such changes exist while retaining its one-repeat loop guard
Regression tests cover unchanged, changed, restored and ignored source paths
constraints: Do not infer semantic progress or create checkpoints automatically
Keep all comparison local, deterministic and independent of providers
checkpoint-freshness.result: Checkpoints now persist deterministic scoped source_hash baselines. Load/status distinguish changed, unchanged, missing and legacy unknown baselines; strict stop prompts an explicit checkpoint for changed source and retains its repeat/blocked/terminal exemptions. Git and non-Git regressions cover edits, additions, deletions, restoration, ignored paths, scope boundaries, task selection, legacy validation and unchanged verification evidence. All four declared verification commands passed.

hook-merge-hardening.title: Preserve arbitrary co-installed hook handlers
acceptance: aiw integrate removes or replaces only exact AIW-owned command handlers
Non-AIW handlers remain unchanged when installed before AIW, after AIW, or beside AIW in the same hook group
Switching strict and observe modes changes only AIW Stop handlers
Unrelated hook-group metadata and top-level settings survive repeated integration
Malformed hook structures fail before integration writes
constraints: Do not add runtime knowledge of or dependencies on another project
Do not claim protection against installers that replace the entire settings file or concurrent uncoordinated writes
hook-merge-hardening.result: Hardened Codex and Claude hook merging to remove only exact AIW command handlers, preserve co-installed handlers and group metadata in either sequential install order, fail before writes on malformed group handlers, and pass 34 CLI integration tests plus the full release contract.

acceptance: Fresh agents recover, claim, checkpoint, verify and hand off interrupted work using only canonical AIW state in at least two independently initialized repositories

The release evidence reports exact commands, results and material limitations without treating provider memory as canonical state
constraints: Keep consumer repositories and their task state independent from AIW repository state
Do not add runtime dependencies on any consumer project or provider service

The coordinator re-verified the combined checkout; provider binaries were available but no authenticated model session was invoked because the trial forbids network/model services.
